description: Header file defining the SimpleFileTracker class, which manages open file handles in a disk cache system, including resource tracking, file acquisition, release, and management of open files to prevent resource exhaustion.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker
classes.description: Manages open file handles for disk cache entries, ensuring resource limits are respected and providing thread-safe access.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker::FileHandle
classes.description: RAII helper class that manages access to a file handle, ensuring safe usage and proper cleanup.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Associates a file with a specific owner and subfile, transferring ownership to the tracker.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Provides a handle to a file for use, managing resource constraints and re-opening if necessary.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases interest in a file, allowing it to be closed and cleaned up.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Marks an entry as doomed, updating its doom generation to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: IsEmptyForTesting
methods.description: Checks if the tracker has no remaining in-memory state; intended for testing.
